intent.proves: At least one active discount carries a condition (user, group, customer number, shop, product, group, total, country, shipping, payment, quantity, field or voucher).

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomDiscount WHERE DiscountActive = 1 AND (ISNULL(DiscountAccessUserId, N'') <> N'' OR ISNULL(DiscountAccessUserGroupId, N'') <> N'' OR ISNULL(DiscountAccessUserCustomerNumber, N'') <> N'' OR ISNULL(DiscountShopId, N'') <> N'' OR ISNULL(DiscountProductsAndGroups, N'') <> N'' OR ISNULL(DiscountOrderTotalPrice, 0) <> 0 OR ISNULL(DiscountCountryCode2, N'') <> N'' OR ISNULL(DiscountShippingId, N'') <> N'' OR ISNULL(DiscountPaymentId, N'') <> N'' OR ISNULL(DiscountProductQuantity, 0) <> 0 OR ISNULL(DiscountOrderFieldName, N'') <> N'' OR ISNULL(DiscountVoucherListId, 0) <> 0)

sources.ref: DW10 database schema (INFORMATION_SCHEMA of a local DW10 install) and Dynamicweb.Ecommerce 10.29.8
